items.title: Karnataka High Court quashes FIR against RTI activist Snehamayi Krishna over alleged threat to State official
items.summary: The Karnataka High Court on Friday quashed criminal proceedings initiated against activist Snehamayi Krishna for allegedly shouting and threatening a government official in her office [ Snehamayi Krishna v State of Karnataka ]. Justice Rajesh Rai K held that the first information report (FIR) against Krishna was a counterblast that was registered after he accused the public official of being involved in the theft of saris from a local temple. The Court passed the order on a petition filed by Krishna to quash the criminal proceedings initiated against him. The Court allowed the petition, holding that the allegations did not amount to the alleged offences of criminal intimidation and assault or use of criminal force to deter a public servant. "I am of the considered view that the entire chargesheet, allegations, entire FIR, complaint taken on its face value tell no offence made out against the petitioner. As such the registration of the FIR and further proceedings against the petitioner would amount in abuse of the process of Court. Accordingly, the petition is allowed," the Court said.
